prompt: Create a highly detailed vertical kawaii anime illustration in a soft pink bedroom filled with teddy bears and sparkling decorations. Center a cute anime girl named Astra with long fluffy twin-tail bubblegum pink hair, glossy magenta-pink eyes, pale skin, a small pouty mouth, and a slightly bashful expression. She wears an elaborate pink idol-lolita dress with layered ruffles, lace trim, checkered pink fabric, bows, frilled wrist cuffs, a corset-style waist ribbon, thigh-high white-and-pink stockings, and multiple teddy-bear accessories. Her twin tails are tied with two oversized pink gingham lace bows, each decorated with a small bear face charm; add a curled ahoge strand above her head. She sits facing the viewer in a plush pastel room and holds a white rectangular sign in front of her chest with large handwritten Japanese text あすとら in thick bright pink brush lettering, plus small doodles: a bow, crown, hearts, stars, wavy lines, and a simple bear face. Her right hand points toward the sign while her left hand grips it. Surround her with exactly 6 visible teddy bears: 1 large bear at lower left raising both arms, 1 medium bear at mid-left beside the sign, 1 bear peeking from the upper-left background, 1 bear at upper-right background, 1 cheerful bear at right middle raising one paw, and 1 large bear at lower-right raising both arms; all bears are beige with pink bow ties and joyful faces. Add white and pink decorative sparkle icons, heart doodles, and emphasis marks around the character, especially at the left and right edges. Background: dreamy pink bedroom with soft-focus curtains, plush bedding or cushions, a warm table lamp, pastel furniture, and more pink decorative details, blurred enough to keep focus on the character. Visual style: polished modern anime key visual, ultra-cute yume-kawaii aesthetic, pastel pink color palette, luminous highlights, soft bloom, glossy eyes, delicate linework, dense lace and fabric detail, high resolution, portrait 3:4 composition, no watermark, no extra readable text beyond the sign.

promptZh: 创作一幅细节极其丰富的竖版可爱风动漫插画，场景设定在一个充满泰迪熊和闪亮装饰的柔粉色卧室中。画面中心是一位可爱的动漫少女，名为 Astra，留着蓬松的长双马尾，发色为 泡泡糖粉，拥有亮泽的洋红色双眼、白皙的皮肤、微微嘟起的小嘴和略显羞涩的表情。她身穿精致的粉色偶像洛丽塔裙，配有层叠的荷叶边、蕾丝花边、粉色格纹布料、蝴蝶结、褶皱腕饰、束腰式腰带、白粉相间的过膝袜以及多个泰迪熊配饰。她的双马尾上系着两个超大的粉色格纹蕾丝蝴蝶结，每个蝴蝶结上都装饰着一个小熊脸挂件；头顶上方加一撮卷曲的呆毛。她正对着镜头坐在柔软的粉色房间里，胸前拿着一块白色长方形牌子，上面用粗体亮粉色笔触手写着日语文字 あすとら，并配有小涂鸦：蝴蝶结、皇冠、爱心、星星、波浪线和一个简单的小熊脸。她的右手指向牌子，左手握住牌子。周围环绕着 6 只清晰可见的泰迪熊：左下方 1 只大熊正举起双臂，左侧中部 1 只中型熊在牌子旁，左上方背景处 1 只熊在探头，右上方背景处 1 只熊，右侧中部 1 只欢快的熊正举起一只爪子，右下方 1 只大熊正举起双臂；所有泰迪熊均为米色，系着粉色领结，表情欢快。在角色周围，特别是在左右边缘，添加白色和粉色的装饰性闪光图标、爱心涂鸦和强调符号。背景：梦幻般的粉色卧室，配有柔焦窗帘、毛绒寝具或靠垫、暖色台灯、粉色家具以及更多粉色装饰细节，背景需进行虚化处理，以保持焦点集中在角色身上。视觉风格：精致的现代动漫主视觉图，超萌梦幻可爱风（yume-kawaii）美学，柔和粉色调，明亮的高光，柔光效果，亮泽的双眼，细腻的线条，密集的蕾丝和布料细节，高分辨率，3:4 竖构图，无水印，除牌子外无其他可读文字。
